title: pr-team bubble_ups sidecar
description: Sidecar file written by `harness:pr-team-fixer` in MODE=PLAN (initial bubbled issues, classified at planning time) and rewritten in MODE=CLOSEOUT (`FAIL` fixer IDs added with classification='fixer_failed'; JSON Schema cannot enforce append-only deltas). Consumed by the QA pass script's Property C4 check. The file lives at `<runtime_dir>/bubble_ups.json` and is namespace-scoped to a single skill invocation.
$comment: Dialect note: this schema and its siblings dispatch_plan.schema.json + terminals.schema.json declare draft-2020-12; the companion PR_REVIEW.schema.json is draft-07. Schemas in this family are draft-2020-12 - do not copy-paste keywords across the dialect boundary.

run_id.description: Verbatim copy of the dispatch plan's run_id; ties this sidecar to its run.

id.description: Issue ID from the consolidated PR review JSON. MUST match an id in issues.{critical,important,minor}[].id.
id.$comment: The field is named id (not issue_id) because every id field in this schema family identifies the entity it lives on - agents use agent_id, issues use id in their parent context. This matches the pattern in PR_REVIEW.schema.json and terminals.schema.json (agent_id is explicit; issue_id is only used in fork-fields where it is distinct from the agent_id field).

oneOf.description: Two or more reasonable - and 'weight-bearing' - resolutions exist; user decision required.
Real issue, but outside this PR's scope.
Requires net-new work exceeding Phase 5 mechanical scope.
A fixer attempted the issue and returned FAIL; added in MODE=CLOSEOUT.

reason.description: One-line freetext explanation. For `fixer_failed`, includes the fixer's FAIL REASON (e.g., 'fixer FAIL: missing file at path X').
reason.$comment: Capped at 200 chars to mirror the FAIL REASON contract in return_contract.md.
